dedupe_keys.name: all africa energy model supply regions for solar pv and wind power

description: This data set gives a representative subset of attractive sites for solar PV and onshore wind power across the African continent, called model supply regions, ready for use in cost-optimisation energy models. It was produced by Sebastian Sterl, Bilal Hussain and Mohamed Elabbas alongside a data paper by Sterl and co-authors in Scientific Data, to close the gap between resource atlases such as the Global Solar Atlas and Global Wind Atlas and the inputs power system planning models need. Sites were screened using resource potential, grid infrastructure, land use and topography, then ranked by expected levelised cost including grid and road extension. The five folders hold feasible-area shapefiles per country, the best 5% of each country's potential with hourly time series, their shapefiles, clustered supply regions with hourly series for the meteorological year 2018, and country maps. Coverage is every mainland African country at kilometre-scale spatial and hourly temporal resolution. Files are RAR archives of spreadsheets, shapefiles and PDF maps on Zenodo (version 1.2.0, February 2025, about 2 GB) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the time series rest on one weather year, and screening criteria and cost assumptions follow the paper. Simulation uses are capacity expansion planning and optimisation of African power systems. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
